headline: Moneyboxx Finance files SEBI Reg. 31(4) disclosure of substantial acquisition
sum: Moneyboxx Finance has filed a mandatory disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations Regulation 31(4) regarding a substantial acquisition of shares, suggesting either a promoter stake change or open market acquisition trigger.
detail: Moneyboxx Finance Limited filed a disclosure with the National Stock Exchange under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This regulation mandates disclosure when a person acquires or is deemed to acquire shares or voting rights exceeding statutory thresholds (5%, 10%, 15%, 20%, 25%, 30%, 40%, 50%, 60%, 75%). The filing suggests a change in substantial shareholding, though the precise acquirer, value, and share count are not disclosed in the article text.
